dex.entry: A small jellyfish-lantern drifting through Pearlmoor harbour. Its translucent bell glows with trapped moonlight, and it fires bioluminescent pulses at threats. A living lantern in the harbour — its gentle glow is the most iconic visual on the Pearlmoor loading screen.

art.silhouette: Dome bell in soft aqua-blue with a warm gold luminescent core; four trailing tendril-ribbons with tiny pearl droplets at their tips, and a cluster of gentle light-spot eyes beneath the bell.
